title: LinearARD: Linear-Memory Attention Distillation for RoPE Restoration
abstract: arXiv:2604.00004v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The extension of context windows in Large Language Models is typically facilitated by scaling positional encodings followed by Continued Pre-Training (CPT). While effective, this paradigm is notoriously data-hungry and computationally expensive, requiring massive long-text corpora to recalibrate the model to the shifted positional distribution. We propose LinearARD, a restoration distillation method that restores Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE)-scaled students through attention-structure consistency with a frozen native-RoPE teacher. translated_title: LinearARD：面向RoPE恢复的线性内存注意力蒸馏
translated_abstract: arXiv:2604.00004v3 公告类型： replace-cross  摘要：大语言模型上下文窗口的扩展通常通过缩放位置编码并随后进行持续预训练（CPT）来实现。尽管有效，但这一范式以极度依赖数据和计算成本高昂而著称，需要海量的长文本语料来将模型重新校准至偏移后的位置分布。我们提出LinearARD，这是一种恢复蒸馏方法，通过与冻结的原生RoPE教师模型进行注意力结构一致性来恢复经RoPE缩放的学生模型。不同于下一个词预测或不透明的隐藏状态匹配，LinearARD对齐最后一层注意力中稠密的 $Q/Q$、$K/K$ 和 $V/V$ 自关系矩阵的逐行分布，从而直接监督注意力动态。为消除 $n \times n$ 关系图的二次方内存瓶颈，我们引入了一种线性激活内存内核，仅存储每个token的log-sum-exp统计量……
tldr: LinearARD提出了一种线性内存的注意力蒸馏方法，通过将经RoPE缩放的学生模型与冻结的原生RoPE教师模型在最后一层注意力的Q/K/V自关系矩阵逐行分布上对齐，以线性内存开销直接恢复注意力结构，从而摆脱传统持续预训练对海量长文本数据的依赖。
en_tdlr: LinearARD is a linear-memory attention distillation method that restores RoPE-scaled student models by aligning row-wise distributions of final-layer Q/K/V self-relation matrices with a frozen native-RoPE teacher, directly supervising attention dynamics while avoiding the data-hungry and costly continued pre-training paradigm.
